title: Integrated Panel Assessment — Post-Developer Corrections
summary: Developer completed all three requested tasks (#1336 LASSO cost fix, #1337 bootstrap validation, #1338 CpG-gene mapping). Key revision: methylation AUC drops from 0.979 (leaked) to 0.882 (corrected LOO-CV). Protein panel also improved from AUC 0.871 to 0.896 via LR optimization. Two-tier architecture simulates 93.2% sensitivity but at 77.4% specificity — below 95% target. All methylation results remain constrained by n=24; external validation cohort is the critical blocker.

B_methylation_only.method: LogisticRegressionCV, LOO-CV with feature selection inside each fold
B_methylation_only.validation_rigor: LOW — n=24, wide CIs, MODERATE overfitting (AUC dropped 0.097 from leaked version)
B_methylation_only.note: Signal is real (p<0.001) but magnitude uncertain due to n=24

C_two_tier_reflex.method: Protein tier 1 [0.139, 0.899] + simulated methylation reflex (binormal, AUC=0.882)
C_two_tier_reflex.validation_rigor: LOW — tier 2 is simulated, not actual paired data
C_two_tier_reflex.change_from_prior: Updated with corrected methylation AUC. Sensitivity stable, specificity dropped.
C_two_tier_reflex.note: Does NOT meet 95% specificity target. Would require paired protein+methylation dataset to validate.

sensitivity_ge_70_at_spec_95.note: Methylation CIs include values both above and below 70% target — cannot confirm.

combined_auc_gt_single_by_5pct.two_tier_vs_protein: Two-tier sens 93.2% >> protein 57.7%, but spec 77.4% << 95% target
combined_auc_gt_single_by_5pct.note: Two-tier uses simulated methylation, not paired data

validation_within_5pct.status: BLOCKED — no independent validation cohort available

stability_analysis.interpretation: Only 1% of candidates are robustly selected across 500 subsamples. The methylation signal concentrates in very few loci. A 3-CpG classifier achieves AUC 1.0 (LOO, n=24) but this is almost certainly overfit — 3 features separating 12 from 12 samples.
stability_analysis.clinical_concern: Extreme feature concentration increases fragility. If any stable CpG fails in a new population, the panel collapses.

cpg_gene_biology.interpretation: The Wnt pathway is well represented (SFRP1, SFRP2) along with established CRC methylation markers (SEPT9, TWIST1, EYA4). Missing BMP3/NDRG4 may reflect platform coverage of GSE149282 rather than biology. SEPT9 is the only FDA-approved blood-based CRC methylation marker.

protein_optimization_results.feature_engineering_impact: Negligible — log transforms, interactions, and polynomial terms do not improve over raw features
protein_optimization_results.note: 6-marker panel without TIMP1 achieves near-identical AUC (0.896 vs 0.896)

critical_issues.detail: Bootstrap CI for sens@95spec spans [46.2%, 100%]. Cannot distinguish 'adequate' from 'useless' with this sample size. OOB bootstrap gives AUC 1.0 uniformly, which is a small-sample artifact, not validation.
critical_issues.blocker: Independent cfDNA methylation validation cohort n>=100 (former task #1340)

critical_issues.detail: Binormal simulation matching AUC 0.882 is not equivalent to actual paired predictions. Correlation structure between protein and methylation biomarkers is unknown.
critical_issues.blocker: Paired protein+methylation dataset from same patients

critical_issues.issue: Stability selection 3-CpG perfect AUC is likely overfit
critical_issues.detail: 3 features perfectly separating 12/12 samples in LOO is expected by chance when features are pre-selected for stability. This is NOT independent validation.
critical_issues.action: Do not report 3-CpG AUC 1.0 as a real performance estimate

critical_issues.issue: Cost sensitivity LASSO AUC 1.0 is training performance
critical_issues.detail: All LASSO panels show AUC 1.0 on the n=24 dataset. This reflects the small sample, not true discriminative ability. Cannot use for architecture selection.
critical_issues.action: Use corrected LOO-CV (AUC 0.882) as the honest methylation performance estimate

critical_issues.detail: Project exists in archive/db.sqlite at 'planning' status but not in active db.sqlite. Tasks cannot be created until project is re-registered.
critical_issues.action: Flag for project_manager or dispatcher to re-register project

recommended_next_steps: 1. CRITICAL: Acquire independent cfDNA methylation validation cohort (n>=100 CRC + 100 control). Without this, methylation results remain preliminary.
2. Re-register crc-liquid-biopsy-panel in active database (project_manager task).
3. Run paired protein+methylation analysis if validation cohort includes both modalities.
4. Consider SEPT9 methylation as standalone marker — it is FDA-approved (Epi proColon) and present in our selection. Direct comparison to our panel would establish added value.
5. Protein panel is ready for advancement: AUC 0.896, 57.7% sens@95spec is honest and reproducible, though below 70% target.
6. Investigate why BMP3/NDRG4 are missing from GSE149282 — platform limitation vs biological absence in cfDNA.

honest_state_of_evidence.what_we_know: A 7-protein panel achieves AUC 0.896 (nested CV, n=121). cfDNA methylation shows corrected AUC 0.882 (LOO, n=24) with moderate overfitting. Two-tier reflex testing could theoretically reach 93% sensitivity at 77% specificity.
honest_state_of_evidence.what_we_dont_know: Whether methylation performance holds in an independent cohort. Whether protein and methylation are truly complementary (no paired data). Whether 3 stable CpGs are sufficient or an artifact of n=24.
honest_state_of_evidence.what_would_change_our_mind: An independent cfDNA methylation cohort (n>=100) showing AUC >0.85 would validate the methylation arm. A paired cohort showing the two-tier architecture maintains >90% sensitivity at >90% specificity would be a significant finding.
